The cached checkouts of samase_scarf and scarf contain no top-level license file.
This notice does not assign an unstated license to those projects.
These are pinned external Git dependencies, not vendored source in this repository.

Chromium Embedded Framework, branch 2357: The Chromium Embedded Framework Authors
Source: https://bitbucket.org/chromiumembedded/cef/src/2357/
The minimal public API declarations in source/lobby/cef2357_minimal.h derive from
CEF's public C headers. The accompanying BSD license is in third-party/cef-2357/LICENSE.txt.

Other dependency revisions/checksums are fixed in source/native/Cargo.lock.
Available dependency license files are preserved under third-party/.
The current native module does not depend on MinHook; historical MinHook notices
from earlier prototypes are not included in this repository.
